title: Petition calls for support of homeschool freedom in District 79
text:
State Representative Jackie Haas (IL) | Representative Jackie Haas (R) 79th District
State Representative Jackie Haas (IL) | Representative Jackie Haas (R) 79th District
Every child deserves access to high-quality education that helps them thrive. Trust is placed in the parents of District 79 to make informed decisions regarding their children's education. There is a commitment to supporting families, ensuring that all Illinois students are safe and have opportunities for growth and success.
"Please make your voice heard by signing the petition here!"
